mod-count-check.desc: Limits how many modules live at each level. Checks that every `mod.rs` and `lib.rs` file declares at most a maximum number of modules (`mod` declarations).

config.item: max - maximum `mod` declarations allowed per file (default 10).
ignore - list of module paths to skip (the directory containing the `mod.rs`/`lib.rs` the check for, relative to the project root, e.g. `src/app`).
